channel.title: The Traitors
channel.desc: It's been an emotional few days for the Faithful, but the Traitors' latest gameplay only makes them more determined than ever to uncover their identity. The mission puts the Traitors under intense pressure, which continues to build at the Round Table as everyone attempts to deflect scrutiny - but who will succeed? While the players spend the evening reflecting on their time in the game, they discover that the Traitors' next move could be a double-edged sword.
